headline: Bank of Japan Expected to Keep Policy Rates Unchanged Amid Sticky Inflation
summary: Market analysts expect a hawkish policy hold from the Bank of Japan at its October meeting as persistent domestic inflation leaves room for further interest rate hikes.
why: The Bank of Japan is gradually dismantling its multi-decade ultra-accommodative monetary policy, a shift with significant implications for global capital flows and FX markets.

impacts.name: Japanese Yen
impacts.why: Hawkish central bank guidance supports currency valuations while an unchanged rate holds back immediate gains.
